text:
Rae: Camera feed looks cropped on viewer side — black bars left/right, presenter's head off-frame. Can camera ops check PTZ presets?
Ben: I'm seeing the same in OBS multiview; output is 1280x720 but camera sending 16:9 1920x1080 causing letterbox scaling.
CamOps: PTZ responded but preset 2 was stuck; cycling to preset 1 now. Will report when reframe confirmed.
StreamBot: Viewer reports spike in buffering + start-of-stream aspect mismatch at 11:45:12 UTC.
Priya: If refocus takes long, can we toggle to wide-shot scene "AH_room_wide" to keep framing and avoid black bars?
CamOps: Switched to AH_room_wide scene. Framing OK but host mic levels low — noticed drop after PTZ move.
Rae: Host says their lav cut out when camera moved. Dana, can you bring up backup lav or phone mic?
Dana: Plugging host phone via TRRS to Y splitter as temp mic. Slight compression but intelligible. Routing it to channel 3 in OBS: `-f dshow -i audio="Line (Phone)"`
Ben: Monitor shows phone mic at -6dB, a little hiss. I'll gate and de-ess. Also enabling local multitrack capture for all channels to S3.
StreamBot: Recording: multitrack enabled; tracks: main, iso_cam, iso_lav_phone. Upload path s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/4332105555/
Rae: Audience chat flagged STT lag ~6-7s. Can we nudge captions to low-latency mode or prioritize live transcript? @Priya
Priya: Switching STT provider to low-latency tier now; may reduce transcript quality slightly. Doing it.
CamOps: PTZ preset 1 is responsive again. Restoring main camera, switching back in 5s.
Ben: Rolling main camera back. OBS scene resize fixed. Levels stable with phone mic. Starting a short buffer to let captions re-sync.
StreamBot: Stream status: degraded->stabilizing; incident length 00:04:04.
Rae: Exec ask: hold roadmap deep-dive until we have a clean asset — we'll move it to next week and surface the top 2 product Qs now.
Priya: Copy. I'll pin two questions in the chat and note the reschedule in notes.
Dana: Uploading three clip segments (pre-tilt, tilt, post-fix) and a short transcript snippet showing the STT skew. ETA 6m.
Rae: Also add INF-9131 to ops for PTZ preset reliability and INF-9132 for runbook addendum about phone-mic fallback & labels.
CamOps: Created INF-9131 and INF-9132, assigned to @CamOps. Linked in meeting notes.
Ben: Final: saving multitrack masters and a mixed broadcast copy. If anyone needs raw iso files ping me.
Rae: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for clip requests and to confirm uploads.
Dana: Clips uploaded and links added to notes. Closing when someone verifies transcript sync.
Priya: Verified captions re-sync; Qs pinned. Ready for hotseat when leadership says go.
